name: Banjul (Gambia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, light blue and yellow, the light blue twice the width of the others, charged at the centre with the arms of the Banjul City Council.
history: The city council, established in 1965 as Bathurst City Council and renamed with the city in 1973, uses arms whose crescents and cross stand for Islam and Christianity, with guns for the town's origin as a garrison and fish for the river. The flag's adoption date is not recorded.

features.role: arms of Banjul with crescents, cross, guns and fish
